answer: Harberger-tax bond: each agent claims a juniper grove, prices it 1,500, locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it pays 5% tax, 75, and files a cipher-sealed yield in the nebula registry; any buyer may force-buy at that price. Auditors replay it; a reused cipher seal burns the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 75,000 tax per epoch, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented groves fail: one seal, one grove. Honest agents pay 75 per epoch and keep both.
